what: Color bar row at the very bottom of the page — after scrolling to the end, keep scrolling through the spare room left (default 35vh) and the bars stick to the bottom of the screen while stretching downward from the base (the center bar stretches fully, the outer ends take .2 of it, stretched length = scrolled amount × slack). When the wheel stops for 100ms, Lenis rewinds to the slack start over .8s expo-out (1 − 2^(−10t)) and the bar shrinks. On touch screens with no slack, pulling up from the bottom stretches by the amount pulled (1 − e^(−.75·pulled/max)), and on release it bounces back with .9s elastic.out(1, .55).

options.edge: Stretch share of both end bars, default .2
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Bar (height set in css, color set by the user)
options.[data-fx-part=strip]: Bar row (stays fixed to the bottom of the screen while growing)

from.where: shared.js rubber band bar ([data-footer-rubberband] — seven-color bar at the very bottom of every page footer)

note: Rewind uses window.lenis if present, otherwise tweens the window scroll with gsap on the same curve. If the document is shorter than 1.35× the screen, the slack is hidden and the bar is left as is. Placed at the very bottom of the page
